newsitem.title: USA: MARKET FACTS CHINA VENTURE APPROVED.
newsitem.headline: MARKET FACTS CHINA VENTURE APPROVED.

text.p: Market Facts Inc said Tuesday its Chinese market research joint venture, All China Market Facts Inc, has been approved by Chinese government authorities to start operation this month.
Market Facts' partner in the joint venture is All China Marketing Research Company Ltd, a privately owned market research company founded in 1992.

"This initiative is part of our international strategic plan to be a preferred supplier to our North American-based clients who have international marketing information requirements," Tom Payne, Market Facts chief executive officer, said in a news release.
Market Facts shares were up 2-7/8 at 20-3/4 Tuesday.
